name: Astana IT University
scholarshipBlurb: Tech-talent grants, digital innovation stipends and partner-company co-funding for strong computing applicants (mock).

tuitionOverview.note: IT-бакалавриат в Astana IT U.; partner-треки и лаборатории могут менять стоимость (mock).

faculties.name: School of Digital Technologies & Computing
faculties.description: Базовый контур AITU: computer science, software engineering, data и робототехника с практикой в продуктовых командах и хакатонах.

faculties.name: Institute of Cybersecurity & Digital Resilience
faculties.description: Защита информации, криптография, SOC-практики и безопасная разработка; сценарии red/blue team и compliance.

faculties.name: School of Digital Economy & Innovation
faculties.description: Цифровой бизнес, продукт, аналитика и инновационное предпринимательство на стыке менеджмента и tech.

faculties.name: Institute of Smart Systems and IoT
faculties.description: Встраиваемые системы, датчики, промышленный IoT и edge-вычисления; прототипирование умных кампусных и городских решений.

faculties.name: Faculty of Digital Economy and Public Sector Innovation
faculties.description: Цифровизация услуг, данные государственных реестров и этика автоматизации — кейсы для smart-city и e-government.

faculties.name: School of Digital Arts and Interaction Design
faculties.description: UX/UI, медиа-дизайн и продуктовый дизайн для IT-сервисов; связка с разработкой через agile-команды учебных студий.

faculties.name: Center for IT Infrastructure Resilience (учебный блок)
faculties.description: Облака, отказоустойчивость, DevOps-практики и эксплуатация больших систем — как дополнительный трек для инженеров платформы.

faculties.name: Institute of Digital Mining, Geoinformatics and Subsurface Data
faculties.description: Геоинформатика, цифровые двойники месторождений и аналитика добывающих данных — трек для казахстанского нефтегазово-горного сектора.

faculties.name: Institute of Financial Technologies, Blockchain and RegTech
faculties.description: Финтех, распределённые реестры, комплаенс и цифровые платежи; лаборатории с банками и IT-регуляторикой (учебные кейсы).

faculties.name: Institute of Educational Technologies and Learning Analytics
faculties.description: LMS, адаптивное обучение, аналитика успеваемости и дизайн цифровых курсов; связка с EdTech-стартапами Астаны.

admissionExpectations.modelNote: AITU ориентирован на IT и цифровую экономику; Fit-модель подчёркивает математику, программирование и английский для англоязычных потоков.

scholarships.name: AITU Digital Talent Grant
scholarships.requirements: Portfolio of coding projects, hackathons or olympiads; competitive GPA; English for English-medium tracks.

scholarships.name: Need-aware tech access award
scholarships.requirements: Documented financial constraints plus satisfactory academic progress; limited seats per cycle (mock).

scholarships.name: Industry partner fellowship
scholarships.requirements: Co-funded placements with technology employers; interview and technical screening — illustrative MVP entry.

scholarships.name: Regional ICT scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Priority for applicants from designated regions of Kazakhstan per annual policy — demo placeholder.

programs.name: BSc in Computer Science
programs.matchReason: Core CS plus cloud and software engineering electives — flagship tech pathway at AITU.
detailedDescription: Programming, discrete math, systems and theory with project-based learning.
Strong ecosystem ties to Astana tech hub — mock narrative.

programs.name: BSc in Big Data Analytics
programs.matchReason: Statistics, distributed systems and ML pipelines — ideal for data-minded applicants.
detailedDescription: Data engineering, visualization and modeling coursework.

programs.name: BSc in Cybersecurity
programs.matchReason: Network security, cryptography labs and blue/red team exercises — hands-on defensive security.
detailedDescription: Ethical hacking basics and secure software development practices.

programs.name: B.A. in Digital Business
programs.matchReason: Product, analytics and digital marketing at the intersection of tech and management.
detailedDescription: Lean startup projects and analytics tooling — mock summary.

programs.name: BSc in Software Engineering
programs.matchReason: End-to-end software delivery, agile teams and quality assurance — strong alignment with product-oriented students.
detailedDescription: Design patterns, testing, DevOps introduction and capstone industry projects.

programs.name: BSc in Robotics and Intelligent Systems
programs.matchReason: Embedded AI, perception and control — bridges mechanical intuition with AI tooling.
detailedDescription: ROS-style projects and interdisciplinary labs — illustrative.
